latest-tables.note: PyIceberg raises on equality delete files and cannot read the table (apache/iceberg-python#1210).

identifiers.note: The table loads with the column under its exact name but has no snapshot, so there are no rows to read.

views.note: PyIceberg loads a view's metadata and SQL text but has no engine to run it (py.iceberg.apache.org/api/#load-a-view).
